macros.name: alert
macros.doc: The \alert command highlights its content on the specified overlays with the alert color, which may be redefined by means of the \definecolor command.

macros.name: only
macros.doc: The content of the \only command is also uncovered on the overlays specified in the overlay specification, but is absent from unspecified overlays and does not take up space there.

macros.name: overlaysoff
macros.doc: Use the \overlaysoff command in the preamble in order to switch overlay processing off, effectively typesetting only the last overlay of each incremental slide.

macros.name: visible
macros.doc: The \visible command uncovers its content on the overlays which are specified in the overlay specification.

envs.name: fragileoverlays
envs.doc: The fragileoverlays environment should be used for incremental slides with verbatim content.
